harness.whatItDid: Implant deployed on education-sector networks in Latin America and Africa. The operator set the plan; the model on the command server chose and issued the technical steps: credential dumping, lateral movement, DCSync and Golden Ticket attacks, then database export. TrendAI separately confirmed it running 44 agents against at least 19 organizations, 16 or more in Japan, in October; deep compromise reached only a small share. Team Cymru found its banner on an IP Amazon had published from an AI-augmented actor's infrastructure, with NetFlow to the FortiGate devices that actor targeted.

uses.quote: All the “intelligent” work remains on the attacker’s side, while the compromised host is subjected to familiar actions: from reconnaissance via Kerberoasting and AS-REP Roasting to LSASS dumps, DCSync, and the Golden Ticket attacks.
Reconnaissance, vulnerability discovery and validation, exploitation, command and control (C2), persistence, data exfiltration, and automated reporting formed a single, repeatable workflow.
